- Cordia: triage ✓
- Jamaal: implement ✓
- Kaci: test ✓
- Brittny: review ✓
- [remaining: docs - unassigned]

- Margery: test ✓

Actually, let me double-check the ISSUE-0001 task list - we have 5 tasks total (triage, implement, test, review, docs). With the current assignments, all 5 will be covered:

- triage: Cordia
- implement: Jamaal  
- test: Kaci
- review: Brittny (me)
- docs: [needs assignment]

- review: Brittny ✓

Ready to commit to ISSUE-0001::test in execution phase. (phase=planning, iter=1)
